description: Smart City Challenge Finalists Project Proposals - Calibration Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by Booz Allen Hamilton and TSS-Transport Simulation Systems. Analysis of the projects proposed by the seven finalists to USDOT's Smart City Challenge, including challenge addressed, proposed project category, and project description. The time reported for the speed profiles are between 2:00PM to 8:00PM in increments of 10 minutes. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 17 columns, among them Description, State, Crosscutting, Environment, Opportunity, CityLocation. The portal shows 2017-01-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: Booz Allen Hamilton and TSS-Transport Simulation Systems. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
